measured_by: src/test/java/com/masson/cruciblecraft/content/multiblock/MultiblockLoadBoundTest.java (JUnit, fake StructureAccess with call counters, 16 rounds, worst-of-N)

network_sync.derivation: ConfiguredProcessingMachineMenu.DATA_COUNT = 3 ContainerData ints (status, status argument, progress permille)

policy: Deterministic operation counts are hard gates; wall-clock elapsed is recorded for reference only and is never gated. Bounds are worst-case, never averaged.

port_scan.derivation: MultiblockPortAggregator.refresh performs one isLoaded + one getBlockEntity per matched port (code-derived); exercised at real scale by the supply GameTests (72/26/25 physical ports)

validation.derivation: one isLoaded + one blockState per structure element at MAX_SCAN_VOLUME (2 x 4096), zero blockEntity reads without ports; port elements add one blockEntity read each
validation.tick_amortization: structure revalidation runs on the 20-tick position phase, so the amortized validation cost is accessor_calls / 20 per tick
